scripts.title: WD7
scripts.features:
[ Auto Sushi Minigame ]
  - As the name suggests.
  - There’s about a 99.99% chance to hit the green, and no chance to hit the yellow.

[ Auto Dish Minigame ]
  - As the name suggests.
  - Not recommended to turn on the instant proximity prompt while washing dishes.

[ Infinite Stamina ]
  - As the name suggests.
  - Does not work with hatchet or knife for harvesting meat.
    - Use chloroform spray for harvesting meat instead.

[ Instant Proximity Prompt ]
  - As the name suggests.

[ Auto Chloroform Spray Minigame ]
  - As the name suggests.

[ Auto Mix Potion ]
  - As the name suggests.
  - Includes information about what each potion does and how it helps when serving customers.

[ Can use the computer during blackout ]
  - As the name suggests.

[ Useful modifier]
  - Sushi make 2x faster
  - Instant clean dishes
  - 100% Sushi duplication chance
  - faster sprintspeed

[ Show Ingredient Stock]
  - As the name suggests.
